name: Sbu Auth

replaces.name: Authenticator ℠ App
replaces.price_model: free download, codes locked behind a weekly subscription after a 3-day trial

one_thing: Shows the two-factor code of your accounts, on this iPhone only.

features.name: TOTP codes
features.description: RFC 6238 with CryptoKit HMAC SHA1/SHA256/SHA512, 6-8 digits, any period; correct at period boundaries and with clock skew of the device (tests with RFC 6238 Appendix B vectors).
features.reason: The one thing; locked behind the paywall in the original.

features.name: HOTP codes
features.description: RFC 4226 counter codes, counter advanced only on explicit tap, persisted before the code is shown (RFC 4226 test vectors).
features.reason: Real otpauth:// QR codes use it; missing in most clones.

features.name: Add from QR (camera)
features.description: DataScannerViewController (fallback AVCaptureMetadataOutput) reads otpauth:// URIs; camera permission asked only on tap.
features.reason: Main setup flow of the original.

features.name: Add from image
features.description: PhotosPicker (no library permission) + Vision barcode detection, for QR codes shown on the same iPhone.

features.name: Manual entry
features.description: Issuer, account, Base32 secret (spaces and lowercase tolerated), advanced: algorithm, digits, period, type.

features.name: Copy with one tap
features.description: Tap a row copies the current code with UIPasteboard localOnly + expiration at the end of the period; VoiceOver announces Copiato.
features.reason: Reviews: users don't know where to paste; codes must not linger in the clipboard or reach Universal Clipboard.

features.name: Account list
features.description: List .insetGrouped with search, codes as statSmall, countdown as text in inkMuted; edit, reorder, delete with SbuButton(kind: .destructive) confirm.
features.reason: Full control is the original's listing promise.

features.name: Face ID lock
features.description: LocalAuthentication with device passcode fallback, on by default; privacy cover in the app switcher (scenePhase); auto-lock on background.
features.reason: Paid in the original; expected by a security user.

features.name: Secure storage
features.description: Secrets in Keychain, kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly, never synchronizable; metadata (order, names) in the same item; nothing in UserDefaults.
features.reason: Data stays on the device; no iCloud (decision below).

features.name: Encrypted backup (mandatory)
features.description: Export all accounts to one .sbuauth file: AES-GCM 256, key from passphrase via PBKDF2-SHA256 (600k iterations, random 16-byte salt) since CryptoKit has no Argon2; versioned header; fileExporter, user picks where. Import with fileImporter, merge without duplicates. After the first account is added and every 5 new accounts, an inline row in the list asks for a backup until one exists; Settings shows the date of the last backup.
features.reason: Pain 4: lost codes means locked out of accounts. Without it Auth cannot launch: the first HN question is 'what if I lose my phone'.

features.name: Import from Google Authenticator
features.description: Decode otpauth-migration://offline?data= (protobuf hand-written decoder, multi-QR batches), from camera or image.
features.reason: Switch in one minute; the original can't.

features.name: Export as QR
features.description: One account at a time as otpauth:// QR (after Face ID), and all accounts as Google Authenticator migration QRs.
features.reason: No lock-in: users can leave Sbu as easily as they arrived.

features.name: Folders
features.reason: Useful with many accounts, not needed at launch.

tool_screen.caption: Codice
tool_screen.figure: the current code of the selected account in statHero, digits grouped 3+3 for reading, tabular figures, closed by SbuFullStop in accent-authenticator
tool_screen.indicator: seconds left as a linear bar in the accent plus the number of seconds as text for VoiceOver (accessibilityValue), no colored warning field; under 5 s the context line says 'Sta per cambiare' with an SF Symbol
tool_screen.notes: One figure per screen: the list does not carry the full stop. Default selection: last copied account.

screens.name: Codice (tool screen)
screens.purpose: The figure: the code of the selected account and its countdown.

screens.name: Account
elements: + menu: Scansiona QR, Da immagine, Inserisci a mano, Importa da Google Authenticator, Importa backup
backup reminder row until a backup exists

screens.name: Aggiungi
elements: Form for manual entry with advanced section

screens.name: Impostazioni
elements: Backup cifrato: Esporta, Importa, ultimo backup

flows.name: Onboarding (first launch)
steps: One screen: 'I codici restano su questo iPhone. Se lo perdi, ti serve un backup.' with Aggiungi il primo account
No permission asked until the user taps Scansiona QR
After the first account: backup row appears in the list

flows.name: Add from QR
steps: Account added, tool screen shows its code

flows.name: Switch from Google Authenticator
steps: In Google Authenticator: Transfer accounts > Export
In Sbu Auth: + > Importa da Google Authenticator
Summary: N accounts added, M already present

flows.name: Backup
steps: Passphrase twice, strength hint, no recovery warning

flows.name: Delete account
steps: Destructive confirm that says the account can't be recovered without a backup

monetization.sbu: free, no IAP, no ads, no account

pains.becomes: honest name, engraved icon, no lookalike (4.1)

pains.pain: Hard to set up, QR not recognised

skipped.reason: Decided: off. The promise of Auth is 'codes never leave this iPhone'; the encrypted file is the backup. ADR-0008 sync stays unused here.
Secrets visible outside the locked app.
ASOneTimeCodeCredential is iOS 18+ only; v1.1 behind #available.
Third-party marks and network; issuer initials in a circle are not used either (no custom icons): SF Symbol key.fill.

skipped.feature: Password manager, breach alerts, browser, VPN

review_risks.risk: Authenticator apps are a crowded category; account under 4.3 watch after 14/10.
review_risks.mitigation: Submit alone; review notes: Google Authenticator import/export, encrypted backup, HOTP, no network; how it differs from other Sbu apps.

review_risks.risk: Lookalike of Google or Microsoft Authenticator.
review_risks.mitigation: Name 'Sbu Auth', engraved icon, no third-party names in metadata.
Review notes include a test otpauth:// QR and its secret (a throwaway, not a real account).
Asked only on Scansiona QR, purpose string IT/EN; PhotosPicker needs none.

launch_assets.screenshots_for_press: 3 Sbu screens only (tool screen, list or bin, settings with the promises); never the Originale's icon or screenshots on the site
launch_assets.video: 20 s vertical 1080x1920, same file on Reels, Shorts and TikTok, from a simulator screen recording (marketing/<slug>/video.md)
